* {{tl|AIV}}, used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|UAA}}, used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|RFPP}}, used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} –used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} –used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} –used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} –used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}

* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates|*]]
</noinclude>

The following templates implement several icons:

* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]
</noinclude>

* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]

* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]
</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them.  Any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]
</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to this but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]
</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]

* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]

* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]

</noinclude>

The following templates implement several icons:

* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

The following templates implement several icons:

* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>
{{Wikipedia templates|state=collapsed}}
[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>
{{Wikipedia templates|state=collapsed}}
[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon/doc]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>
{{Wikipedia templates|state=collapsed}}
[[Category:Documentation see also templates]]
[[Category:Image with comment templates| ]]

</noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser]]s
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], inline icon templates by shape and color
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|BOTREQ}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Bot requests]]
* {{tl|CPC}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Copyright problems]]
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|UND}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for undeletion]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|BOTREQ}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Bot requests]]
* {{tl|CPC}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Copyright problems]]
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|RFPC}}, {{tl|RFPNPR}}, {{tl|RFPPM}}, {{tl|RFPR}} – used by subpages of [[Wikipedia:Requests for permissions]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|UND}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for undeletion]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|BOTREQ}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Bot requests]]
* {{tl|CPC}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Copyright problems]]
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|RFPC}}, {{tl|RFPNPR}}, {{tl|RFPPM}}, {{tl|RFPR}} – used by subpages of [[Wikipedia:Requests for permissions]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|UND}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for undeletion]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|BOTREQ}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Bot requests]]
* {{tl|CPC}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Copyright problems]]
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|RFPC}}, {{tl|RFPNPR}}, {{tl|RFPPM}}, {{tl|RFPR}} – used by subpages of [[Wikipedia:Requests for permissions]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|UND}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for undeletion]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], a template that creates an inline icon/image that is used in metapages
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|BOTREQ}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Bot requests]]
* {{tl|CPC}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Copyright problems]]
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|RFPC}}, {{tl|RFPNPR}}, {{tl|RFPPM}}, {{tl|RFPR}} – used by subpages of [[Wikipedia:Requests for permissions]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|UND}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for undeletion]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], a template that creates an inline icon/image that is used in metapages
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>
* {{Commons-inline|Template:Polling template/see also|Template:Polling template}}

===Multi-sign templates===
The following templates implement several icons:
* {{tl|AIV}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Administrator intervention against vandalism]]
* {{tl|AN3}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Administrators' noticeboard]] and its subpages
* {{tl|BOTREQ}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Bot requests]]
* {{tl|CPC}} - used by [[Wikipedia:Copyright problems]]
* {{tl|CUI}} - used by [[Wikipedia:CheckUser|CheckUsers]]
* {{tl|EFFP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/False positives]]
* {{tl|EFR}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Edit filter/Requested]]
* {{tl|EP}} – used for servicing requests in edit-protected areas
* {{tl|RFPP}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for page protection]]
* {{tl|RFPC}}, {{tl|RFPNPR}}, {{tl|RFPPM}}, {{tl|RFPR}} – used by subpages of [[Wikipedia:Requests for permissions]]
* {{tl|UAA}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Usernames for administrator attention]]
* {{tl|UND}} – used by [[Wikipedia:Requests for undeletion]]
* {{tl|Smiley}} – used for informal communication purposes

===Others===
* [[Template:Check mark templates]], for templates like these but without text
* [[Template:Icon]], a template that creates an inline icon/image that is used in metapages
* [[Wikipedia:List of discussion templates]], a more linear table of essentially the same set of templates
* [[Template:Resolved/See also]], the smaller family of thread-level hatnote templates, similar to the above but with a box around them; any template above can be converted to one of those with {{tl|Resbox}}
* [[Template:Table cell templates/doc]], the family of table-specific templates that work only in tables
* [[:Category:Image with comment templates]]
* [[:Category:Resolution templates]]<noinclude>
* [[File:Commons-logo.svg|16x16px|class=noviewer]] Media related to [[:Commons:Template:Polling template/see also|Template:Polling template]] at Wikimedia Commons
